remarks: Discover this stunning Colonial home, set on a premier cul-de-sac next to a Land Trust preserve, just minutes from Town and perfect for walking or jogging. Spanning over 5,000 sqft across three beautifully finished levels, this home impresses with a bright, open concept floor plan, cathedral ceilings, and Palladian windows that frame picturesque pond views. Both the front and back yards are adorned w/perennial gardens, professional landscape lighting and wooded areas, enhancing the home's privacy. The spacious family room is bathed in natural light, boasting a gas log fireplace, custom-built bookcase/entertainment center, and double sets of French doors leading to a generous deck - ideal for indoor-outdoor living. The chef's kitchen offers ample counter space and a convenient layout for both cooking and entertaining, and direct access to the formal dining room, perfect for hosting gatherings, w/plenty of room for a large dining set. A sophisticated formal living room w/a gas log fireplace leads to a private office w/ tranquil water views, creating an inspiring work-from-home retreat. Upstairs, the primary suite features vaulted ceilings and spa-like bath, while 3 additional en-suite bedrooms provide comfort and privacy for family or guests. The 3rd-floor walk-up attic offers abundant storage and the potential for future expansion. The bright lower level has a rec-room w/custom built-ins, full bath, and a slider that opens to a patio.
